excluded.title: Library of Congress digitized books (pre-1931, online text)
excluded.excluded_reason: www.loc.gov answered every request on 2026-10-03 with HTTP 429 and a Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge), although robots.txt allows /books/ and /item/ with a 5-second crawl delay. The challenge was not bypassed. Retry later from the same identified client; many LOC books are also IA-derived scans (gdcmassbookdig), already covered by the Internet Archive set.
